title: Unforgettable Mediterranean Vegetable Salad
description: A savory and pillowy Mediterranean dish featuring raw vegetables and infused oil, perfect for a low-glycemic friendly meal.

ingredients.name: bell peppers
ingredients.notes: any color, seeded and thinly sliced

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sliced cucumber, bell peppers, cherry tomatoes, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, and minced garlic.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley over the top of the salad.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in the pitted kalamata olives.
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
